fields.q: 妈妈的婚姻失败了，不代表女儿也会犯同样的错。对吧？
fields.en: Just because a mom's marriage failed doesn't mean her daughter will make the same mistake. Right?
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 妈妈的婚姻失败了，不代表女儿也会犯同样的错。对吧？

en.value: Just because a mom's marriage failed doesn't mean her daughter will make the same mistake. Right?

fields.q: 我唱歌不太好。我喜欢唱，可是总跑调。
fields.en: I'm not the best singer. I enjoy it, but I can't carry a tune.
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 我唱歌不太好。我喜欢唱，可是总跑调。

fields.q: 要是酒馆里有个家伙闹事，我得一拳揍晕他。是不是该避开脸？
fields.en: Say there's a guy in the tavern causing a fuss and I need to punch him out. Should I avoid the face?
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 要是酒馆里有个家伙闹事，我得一拳揍晕他。是不是该避开脸？

fields.q: 我姐姐教我做饭。她超厉害的。尝一口心都要飞起来了。
fields.en: My sister taught me how to cook. She's incredible. One taste and your heart just soars.
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 我姐姐教我做饭。她超厉害的。尝一口心都要飞起来了。

en.value: My sister taught me how to cook. She's incredible. One taste and your heart just soars.

fields.q: 不知道你这身子里有多大力气。要不我轻轻捏一下试试？
fields.en: I wonder how much strength is in that body. Maybe I should just give you a little squeeze.
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 不知道你这身子里有多大力气。要不我轻轻捏一下试试？

en.value: I wonder how much strength is in that body. Maybe I should just give you a little squeeze.

fields.q: 欠债可不好。只要债还压在身上，就没法好好思考。
fields.en: Owing debts is no good. As long as they're hanging over you, you can't think straight.
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 欠债可不好。只要债还压在身上，就没法好好思考。

en.value: Owing debts is no good. As long as they're hanging over you, you can't think straight.

fields.q: 钱是苦难的根源。不过你不用担心这个！
fields.en: Money is the root of hardship. Not that you need to worry about that!
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 钱是苦难的根源。不过你不用担心这个！

en.value: Money is the root of hardship. Not that you need to worry about that!

fields.q: 在外面要小心。看到可疑的人就赶紧飞走！
fields.en: Be careful out there. If you see someone suspicious, just fly off, quick as you can!
fields.name: 米迦艾拉

q.value: 在外面要小心。看到可疑的人就赶紧飞走！

fields.q: 变强是好事。这样到了该把没用的丈夫踢出门的时候，你就准备好了！
fields.en: It's good to get strong. That way you're ready when it's time to kick out your good-for-nothing husband!
fields.name: 米迦艾拉
